mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.class_id, s.course_id, s.teacher_id, s.classroom, s.day_of_week, s.period, s.create_time, co.course_name, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN course co ON s.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.teacher_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.day_of_week, s.period
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (class_id, course_id, teacher_id, classroom, day_of_week, period) VALUES (#{classId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{classroom}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{period})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
